caption: The drawing depicts a large stoneware jug positioned upright in the center, with a single curved handle attached to its neck near the top opening. The jug is colored in shades of beige, light gray, and brown, with dark areas indicating shadows and highlights that suggest a reflective glazed surface. The left side of the jug is decorated with a blue floral or swirling pattern. Next to the jug at the lower left corner is a separate, detailed rendering of the same blue decorative pattern seen on the jug. In the upper right of the composition, there is an inset illustration of a rectangular pottery mark reading "WEST TROY N.Y. POTTERY" in blue lettering, above a blue insignia. The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular line, and the artist's name "chas. Oiseau" is written at the bottom right within the border. All elements are set against an off-white background.
title: Jug
